text:
maria_g: kicking off rolling deploy for release v2.9.3 to prod in change-window (02:00-04:00 UTC). canary groups: eu-west + us-east, 5% traffic. deploy id dpl-20250315-34. watching SLOs and errors. link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/dpl-20250315-34

deploybot: Deployment started: dpl-20250315-34 -> prod. canary weight 5%. hooks: observability-smoke, kvcache-warm. ETA ~3m for first traffic shift. :rocket:

kai: noted. I'll start the smoke checks and watch p95/p99 across regions. running quick query on traces now.

sre_oncall: alert: small p95 bump in eu-west service=runtime-proxy, p95 220ms -> 480ms, baseline 190ms. 5xx rate up from 0.03% -> 0.38% in the last 2m. tagging as watch-only for now.

maria_g: keeping canary at 5% for 10m and monitor. @kai can you check error logs for chaining issues (kv fetch / prefix cache)?

kai: checking logs... one pod in eu-west (runtime-pt-2) shows repeated WARNs: "kv cache miss -> fallback to cold load". snippet:
```
[2025-03-15T02:03:12Z] WARN runtime: prefix cache miss keys=37 module=kv-cache
[2025-03-15T02:03:13Z] ERROR http: upstream 10.12.8.4:502 timed out
```

jamie: could be a quantize kernel mismatch on that instance type. v2.9.3 bumped cuda kernels, some nodes still running older driver. pinging infra.

ops-bot: infra-ticket #INFR-4321 opened: eu-west node driver mismatch suspected. Assigned to @infra-team.

maria_g: two options: 1) pause canary and pin traffic back to v2.9.2, 2) hold at 5% and shrink canary (drain the affected pod pool). prefer to avoid full rollback if we can mitigate quickly. thoughts?

sre_oncall: recommend hold at 0% traffic until infra team confirms driver parity. 5xx rate crossing our canary abort threshold (0.2%).

kai: I can drain the affected pod pool and rewarm kvcache on fresh pods. command I'll run: `kubectl cordon runtime-pt-2 && kubectl drain runtime-pt-2 --ignore-daemonsets && rollout restart deployment/runtime --namespace=prod-eu-west`

maria_g: do it. I'll pause the traffic ramp. deploybot: pause canary for dpl-20250315-34 and maintain 0% additional shift.

deploybot: Canary pause acknowledged. current canary weight frozen at 5% (no further ramp). Reason: manual hold by @maria_g.

kai: draining now, rewarming cache on new pods. tailing logs: rewarm started.

sre_oncall: p95 trending down in eu-west after drain, p95 -> 260ms, 5xx -> 0.05%. still watching for flapping.

maria_g: infra confirmed driver bump issue on subset, infra will push driver to nodes in maintenance. ETA 18m. given the drop in errors, I propose to keep canary paused and let infra finish, then continue ramp if stable.

jamie: agree. also creating a quick release note: v2.9.3 includes kernel bump; recommend node driver parity check before full rollout. I'll add to release notes and postmortem if rollback occurred.

ops-bot: ticket #INFR-4321 status updated: in-progress. ETA 18m.

maria_g: opening a follow-up action: if 5xx > 0.2% in next 10m, rollback to v2.9.2. @deploybot please stand by for rollback command.

sre_oncall: adding an alert mute on noise channels but keeping page for oncall if abort threshold breached.

(deploybot system message): Reminder: to rollback run `deploybot rollback dpl-20250315-34 --to release=v2.9.2 --force`

kai: rewarm complete. heatmap looks good for new pods. no cache miss errors in last 3m.

maria_g: infra reports drivers patched on affected nodes. canary remains paused at 5% for one more validation window (10m).

(10 minutes pass)

sre_oncall: final check: p95 eu-west 195ms, 5xx 0.02%, error traces show no regressions. OK to continue.

maria_g: thanks. deploybot: resume ramp for dpl-20250315-34, proceed to 25% after smoke hold, then standard ramp.

deploybot: Resuming canary: increasing to 25% over 2m. will report on each checkpoint.

jamie: adding follow-up doc in docs/releases: note about kernel/driver preflight for future rollouts.

maria_g: closing change-window summary: held canary due to infra driver mismatch -> drained affected pods -> infra patched drivers -> resumed ramp. no rollback required. I'll write a short postmortem and link INFR-4321. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: change-window closed. summary posted to #release-ops.
